deploy-bot: Deploy started for release v2.9.1 -> canary (3%)
deploy-bot: <https://deploys.redwood.ai/releases/2.9.1|release/2.9.1> triggered by @sara
sara (eng-releases): Hold the canary — prompt eval gate failing on evalset 'prod-prompts-2026'

eval_summary: prod-prompts-2026
- avg_pass@threshold: 85.6 (-3.2)

qa-bot: Automated QA: regression detected on 'prod-prompts-2026' with drop >3% in avg_pass. Canary paused. Ticket created: <https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-4821|INC-4821>

maria (ml-lead): I'll own the eval triage, will run targeted eval subsets and post results in this thread.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 3%. Rollback requested by @sara. Starting rollback job.
kevin (platform): Thanks. After rollback, schedule a controlled canary with evaluation gate enforced and explicit ML approval.
sara (eng-releases): Agreed. No override. If urgent patch required, ML + ENG approval only. :thumbsup:
